before: Frozen after the preserved-incumbent continuation raised the n83 development balanced accuracy and before generating or examining the independent replication dataset.
question: Can the same checkpoint-and-challenge decision run from an empty directory through the normal solve command, and does its benefit repeat on independently generated observations?
method: Introduce opt-in protected self-review. The active planner first freezes its normal winner. If its remaining total fits can pay for two matched training checks and a full refit, take the highest-ranked affordable untried method from its existing final menu, preserving the incumbent model. Replace only after higher declared metric on both folds and mean gain at least 0.003. Use the same rules on every task; the previous study used this exact gate.

reproduction.criteria: Identical exploration history up to the first stop, same incumbent, candidate, two checked training scores, same decision, total fits and byte-identical held predictions as the archived automatic continuation.

independent.data: Same 1000-row 3-class numeric generator parameters as n83, entirely new generator seed 941228 and stratified outer seed 730358. Balanced accuracy. Freeze both predictions before opening labels; no task ID selects a candidate.

decision: Keep the d501807 submission floor. A successful replay makes the feature usable from the ordinary entry. A fresh generator seed provides one independent check, without implying general classification gains.
